name: Export And Import Performance Plan
description: Make project transfer import and export scale to large projects without high memory pressure, long DuckDB writer occupancy, or opaque progress.

userStories.title: Add transfer performance instrumentation
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want project-transfer import and export phases instrumented so performance changes can be measured before architecture changes land.
acceptanceCriteria: Add phase timing for upload, zip scan, payload parse, staging/load, target analysis, dependency resolution, revalidation, asset promotion, app-table writes, history write, cleanup, export assembly, and export package write.
Record row counters keyed by the active `projectTransferPayloadKeys` surface, including current-schema payload keys before cutover and first-class asset-entry/reference counters after schema-vNext.
Record byte counters, sampled peak memory, DuckDB writer transaction timing, warning counts by code/scope/severity, and the required before/after benchmark fields from the plan.
Mark missing metrics as `unavailable`, never `0`, and keep `usesStreamingParser` false until upload, zip entry, and NDJSON parsing are actually streaming.
Add or update a benchmark runner entrypoint `bun run bench:project-transfer` with fixture selection and machine-readable output.
`bun test src/server/routes/projectTransferRoutes.test.ts` passes if route progress payloads change.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Add schema-vNext transfer contracts
userStories.description: As an implementer, I need schema-vNext payload, manifest, path, and fingerprint contracts so streaming import and export share one deterministic package format.
acceptanceCriteria: Add one new transfer `schemaVersion` for the streaming cutover and bind payload paths, manifest validation, archive root allowlists, canonical ordering, package-validation semantics, and fingerprint rules to that schema version.
Represent schema-vNext asset entries and asset references as explicit package payloads with payload paths, manifest entries, row counts, byte counts, checksums, and fingerprint inputs.
Keep current-schema packages on current root files and `assetManifest.json` behavior until the schema-vNext importer and exporter ship together or remain behind the same cutover branch/flag.

Compute schema-vNext logical fingerprints from staged row digests and singleton payload digests, proving source ids, target ids, DB ids, timestamps, and other excluded fields cannot affect row ordering through `sortKey`.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferContracts.test.ts` passes.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferManifest.test.ts` passes with schema-vNext asset-entry/reference manifest coverage.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferPaths.test.ts` passes with schema-version-aware archive root allowlists.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferPayloadSchemas.test.ts` passes with schema-vNext asset-entry/reference payload contracts.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferFingerprint.test.ts` passes with row-order exclusion coverage.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Add request-safe staging lifecycle
userStories.description: As an importer, I want staged package rows to survive normal request gaps without relying on connection-local temp tables or partial files.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a transfer staging abstraction keyed by session id and `stagingRevision`, with temp-root files or app-scoped scratch as the cross-request source of truth.
Write each staging revision under a non-current path, verify counts/checksums/blockers/plan artifacts, then atomically publish the current `stagingRevision`.
Require dependency resolution and commit to reject requests whose reviewed plan points at a non-current `stagingRevision`, while allowing later plan revisions to reuse the same staged package rows.
Add deterministic cleanup for cancel, failure, expiry, successful commit, and startup cleanup after checking writer ownership, session state, and owner lease.
Lost staged state fails or expires the session clearly and never allows partial commit.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferSessionRecovery.test.ts` passes with stale `stagingRevision` cleanup coverage.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferSessionRepository.test.ts` passes with atomic current-`stagingRevision` publish and reviewed-plan staging validation.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Stream import package scan into staging
userStories.description: As an importer, I want upload artifacts, archive entries, and NDJSON rows loaded into staging without materializing full package payloads in JavaScript arrays.
acceptanceCriteria: Stream NDJSON payloads into staging without `decode(...).split('\n').map(JSON.parse)` and validate per-row payload shape while streaming.
Write staged validation failures as blocker records, include them in the plan summary, and block commit while any package-contract blocker remains unresolved.
Track staged row counts, byte counts, checksums, logical digests, package fingerprint inputs, source project metadata, and asset bytes as rows are loaded.
Extend import-side resource gates so disk headroom budgets staged payload files, canonical row bytes, digests, manifests, and temporary spill before staging starts.
Pre-cutover staging validates current schema/fingerprint behavior; schema-vNext validation only activates with the matching exporter/importer cutover.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferAnalyze.test.ts` passes.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferZip.test.ts` passes if archive scanning behavior changes.
Run `bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=article-heavy-package` and record parse/load memory and rows/sec before/after.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Add operation-local table loading
userStories.description: As an implementer, I need staged rows loaded into operation-local DuckDB tables safely so analyze, dependency resolution, and commit can use joins without cross-request temp-table assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Rebuild operation-local DuckDB tables from persisted staged files at the start of analyze, dependency revalidation, and commit when needed.
Execute multi-statement work that depends on operation-local tables on the same helper-managed operation connection, or use app-scoped scratch tables keyed by operation id or commit id.
Use per-operation temp-table names plus guaranteed teardown, or add any dedicated connection mode through the shared DuckDB service/helper layer rather than ad hoc connection management.
Add indexes, sort order, or `ANALYZE` calls for operation-local tables only when query plans need them.
If app-scoped scratch tables or transfer metadata migrations are added, `bun run db:mig` passes.
If migrations are added or changed, `bun test src/db/migrateDuckdb.test.ts` passes.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferAnalyzeTarget.test.ts` passes with same-operation connection coverage for temp tables.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Implement set-based article and route analysis
userStories.description: As an importer, I want article, prompt, and route matching computed with DuckDB joins so target analysis scales linearly instead of building giant SQL strings.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace article id and identifier `IN (...)` or `OR` predicates with joins from staged article ids and normalized strong identifiers to `app.article` and `app.article_identifier`.
Compute article match actions, route availability, route/article overlap, and article field-fill candidates in SQL or operation-local plan tables.
Compute prompt matches by joining recomputed staged prompt content hashes to `app.prompt`; use package-declared hashes only for mismatch warnings, not reuse decisions.
Remove plan shapes that store full duplicate target row payloads unless the UI explicitly needs them.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferAnalyzeTarget.test.ts` passes with recomputed prompt-content-hash, normalized strong article identifier, and staged blocker coverage.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferIdentifierNormalization.test.ts` passes.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferDuplicateDetection.test.ts` passes.
Run `bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=conflict-heavy-package` and record target-analysis SQL size and wall time before/after.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Implement staged dependency and fidelity planning
userStories.description: As an importer, I want provider/model dependency and fidelity planning to use staged rows and exact imported snapshot fingerprints so benchmark-critical settings are preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Stage imported provider/model snapshot markers and dedicated snapshot fingerprints, reusing only rows previously marked as imported snapshots when fingerprints match exactly.
Preserve model `variant` and `version` as separate staged fields and snapshot-fingerprint inputs throughout analysis, dependency resolution, reviewed plans, and commit materialization.
Compute judgment, assessment, and human-review fidelity plans from concrete or virtual imported snapshot ids without remapping source providers/models onto arbitrary local rows.
Change dependency resolution to read staged provider, model, judgment, assessment, and human-review rows instead of reparsing extracted payload files into full arrays.
Ensure dependency resolution and commit read exactly the reviewed plan revision.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferDependencyResolution.test.ts` passes with imported snapshot reuse and virtual id coverage.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferSnapshotFingerprint.test.ts` passes with provider runtime config, imported marker, disabled reuse, and variant/version handling.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferFidelityValidation.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Add target-state dirty token coverage
userStories.description: As an importer, I need target-state dirty tokens and coverage metadata so commit can skip full revalidation only when every safety surface is known unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a shared target-state dirty-token or version service for projects, articles, identifiers, import routes, project links, prompts, judgments, assessments, human review rows, models, provider connections, imported snapshot markers, snapshot fingerprint inputs, and project-transfer history.
Store a target-state coverage version that records which code version initialized token coverage, which safety surfaces are covered, and the dependency fingerprint algorithm/code version.
Update dirty tokens transactionally through shared write helpers inside existing write paths; direct maintenance scripts must update tokens transactionally or advance a global unknown token.
Incremental revalidation remains disabled by default until coverage is initialized for every safety surface.
If target-state dirty-token migrations are added, `bun run db:mig` passes.
If migrations are added or changed, `bun test src/db/migrateDuckdb.test.ts` passes.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferDirtyTokenRevalidation.test.ts` passes with missing-token fallback and coverage-version behavior.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Implement incremental commit revalidation
userStories.description: As an importer, I want commit to skip full target analysis when the reviewed plan's dirty-token coverage proves the target state is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Store analyze-time coverage version and dirty-token set with every reviewed plan revision.
At commit, compare current dirty tokens with analyze-time tokens before detailed revalidation and fall back to full target revalidation on any missing, unknown, stale, or uncovered token.

Fall back to full dependency and fidelity revalidation when imported snapshot markers, snapshot fingerprint inputs, provider/model enabled/archive state, or dependency fingerprint code/version are missing, unknown, stale, or changed.
Persist stale-plan reasons by surface: dependency, target project, target article, target prompt, target route, judgment, assessment, human review, and duplicate package history.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferDirtyTokenRevalidation.test.ts` passes with changed-surface, coverage-version mismatch, and full-revalidation fallback coverage.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferCommit.test.ts` passes if commit revalidation behavior changes.
Run `bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=reuse-heavy-package` and record unchanged-target revalidation time before/after.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Add commit id maps and snapshot materialization
userStories.description: As an importer, I need reviewed commit plans to materialize stable target ids and imported provider/model snapshots before set-based writes consume them.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate new target ids once per reviewed commit attempt, validate collisions before writes, and persist source-to-target id maps in request-safe staging or a reviewed commit plan artifact.
Rebuild operation-local id mapping tables from persisted maps at commit time on the same DuckDB connection used by dependent writes.

Materialize imported provider/model snapshots as disabled rows with imported-snapshot markers and no usable provider secret reference before dependent judgment, assessment, human-review, or project rows are written.
Reuse exact imported snapshot matches by fingerprint and materialize only remaining virtual `new:provider:*` and `new:model:*` snapshots.
Persist source model `version` in imported snapshot marker/fingerprint metadata instead of folding it into `variant` when no dedicated app-table version column exists.

`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferCommit.test.ts` passes with disabled snapshot materialization, exact-match reuse, repeated-import behavior, and separate `variant`/`version` preservation.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferSnapshotFingerprint.test.ts` passes with dependency-resolution and commit-materialization parity.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Convert article and route commit writes
userStories.description: As an importer, I want article, identifier, route, and project-link commit writes to use set-based SQL so large imports avoid sequential literal insert batches.
acceptanceCriteria: Convert created-article inserts to `INSERT ... SELECT` from staged article rows and target id maps.
Convert reused-article field-fill updates to set-based `UPDATE ... FROM` statements from staged update-plan rows and the promoted-path map, with affected-row count validation.
Convert article identifier inserts from staged normalized strong identifiers and prove every skipped `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` row belongs to the intended target article.
Convert article import route, project import route, and project article inserts to set-based writes from staged plan rows.
Advance target-state dirty tokens transactionally inside the same set-based commit transaction for every safety surface these writes touch.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferCommit.test.ts` passes with same-connection operation-local table consumption and normalized strong identifier conflict validation.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferDirtyTokenRevalidation.test.ts` passes with set-based commit dirty-token advancement coverage.
Run `bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=article-heavy-package` and record commit rows/sec and writer transaction duration before/after.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Convert judgment and review commit writes
userStories.description: As an importer, I want judgment, assessment, human judgment, summary, and review writes to be set-based while preserving fidelity, rollback, and history semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Convert judgment inserts to set-based writes from staged judgment rows joined to article, prompt, and model maps.
Convert judgment assessment inserts to set-based writes from staged assessment rows joined to judgment maps.
Convert human judgment, human summary, and review inserts to set-based writes from staged human-review plan rows.
Keep count/key validation for `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` paths and remove only post-insert scans fully proven by constraints and insert result counts.
Preserve one commit transaction, rollback, history rows, dirty-project marking, completion payload semantics, and failure tests proving partial set-based writes roll back cleanly.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferCommit.test.ts` passes for judgment, assessment, and human-review set-based writes.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferCommitRecovery.test.ts` passes.
Run `bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=judgment-heavy-package` and record commit rows/sec and writer transaction duration before/after.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Stream asset promotion with rollback safety
userStories.description: As an importer, I want asset promotion to stream copies with bounded concurrency and persisted rollback state so asset-heavy imports do not reread entire files repeatedly.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace whole-file asset reads with stream copy and incremental checksum, and avoid rereading promoted assets when the copy path already verified byte count and checksum.
Keep asset promotion before app-table writes and fail before any DB write when required asset copies cannot be verified.
Persist session-scoped promotion status with each asset recorded pending before copy and copied only after byte count/checksum verification.
Serialize concurrent promotion-state updates through one manifest writer, append-only log, or atomic per-asset state files so pending/copied rollback state cannot be lost.
Keep promoted asset paths session-owned and preserve path traversal, symlink, declared reference, and runtime asset URL rewriting safety checks.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferCommitRollback.test.ts` passes with bounded-concurrency manifest coverage.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferCommitRecovery.test.ts` passes.
Run `bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=asset-heavy-package` and record asset bytes/sec, peak memory, asset read count, and rollback cleanup time before/after.
Browser verify imported asset paths and full-text HTML render after import.
Desktop verify imported runtime asset rendering if runtime asset paths or temp paths change.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Stage export payloads from one snapshot
userStories.description: As an exporter, I want large export payloads materialized into deterministic staged files from one consistent source snapshot without holding DB rows in memory.
acceptanceCriteria: Add export disk-headroom gates at preflight and export-start using estimated staged payload bytes, asset bytes, and package bytes.
Run export assembly against one consistent DuckDB snapshot and materialize export rows plus asset references/paths into request-safe staged files before releasing it.
Do not hold a DuckDB transaction open across asset copy or package streaming.
Stream payload assembly from DuckDB queries into deterministic NDJSON files instead of collecting large payload arrays.
Keep small inline package output and large background package-file output paths available.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferExport.test.ts` passes for small inline packages, large background package-file output, and snapshot-consistent payload rows.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferExportPackage.test.ts` passes if package staging changes.
Run `bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=article-heavy-export` and record export assembly time and peak memory before/after.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Stream export asset collection
userStories.description: As an exporter, I want runtime asset references discovered and copied into package staging with bounded memory while preserving current external URL behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Discover asset references while materializing article payloads under the DuckDB snapshot, then copy asset files after the snapshot with bounded concurrency.
Compute asset byte counts/checksums incrementally and preserve stable-source verification so assets that change during copy fail export before manifest and fingerprint finalization.
Preserve runtime asset path validation, runtime asset URL rewriting, symlink rejection, regular-file checks, and source-change-during-copy failure behavior.
Define and enforce a field-specific URL policy matrix for `fullTextHtml`, `fullTextPdf`, and `fullTextAssets`; preserved non-local URLs must never be reinterpreted as runtime asset paths.
Preserve current no-warning external URL behavior unless a separate correctness change intentionally reintroduces `nonLocalUrlPreserved` warnings.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferExportAssets.test.ts` passes with field-specific URL policy and signed/credential non-local URL coverage.
Add and run `bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferRedaction.test.ts` if redaction or external-URL behavior changes.
Run `bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=asset-heavy-export` and record asset bytes/sec and JS memory before/after.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Finalize export signatures and fingerprints
userStories.description: As an exporter, I want payload signatures, checksums, and fingerprints computed from final staged package bytes so same-branch import fidelity matches export output.
acceptanceCriteria: Build judgment, assessment, human-review, and review payload signatures from staged article payloads after runtime asset rewriting, not from pre-rewrite DB article rows.
Preserve benchmark-critical model, provider, thinking, content-setting, judgment, `variant`, and `version` settings exactly without retries, downgrades, or setting mutation.
Compute package checksums and fingerprints from staged payload files, staged asset metadata, and streaming logical digest inputs.
Support `rawArticleProvenanceMode` `include` and `omit` preflight estimates, execution mode, package output, manifest warnings, and same-branch import behavior without reintroducing `auto`.
Add golden package/fingerprint tests for schema-vNext, asset-entry/reference payloads, and model `variant`/`version` fingerprint parity.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferExport.test.ts` passes with post-rewrite article-dependent signatures and raw provenance include/omit coverage.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferFingerprint.test.ts` passes.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferManifest.test.ts` passes if checksum or manifest metadata changes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Stream zip package writing
userStories.description: As an exporter, I want package zips written from staged files or streams with valid headers so large exports do not re-materialize every entry as `Uint8Array`.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend the zip writer to accept staged files or streams for large payloads and assets.
For streamed entries, either precompute CRC32 and uncompressed size during staging and write correct local headers, or implement ZIP data descriptors correctly.
Persist per-entry CRC32, uncompressed size, content checksum, and package path metadata when using precomputed headers so package writing does not reread large entries solely for header values.
Keep package-level byte counts and checksums based on bytes actually written, not advisory archive metadata.

`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferZip.test.ts` passes with streamed file/stream entries, staged CRC32/uncompressed-size metadata, correct central-directory metadata, and package checksum coverage.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferExportPackage.test.ts` passes.
Run `bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=asset-heavy-export` and record package write bytes/sec and peak memory before/after.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Ship same-branch schema cutover
userStories.description: As a project-transfer user, I want schema-vNext export and import to ship together so packages created by the branch import successfully while unsupported old packages fail clearly.
acceptanceCriteria: Wire schema-vNext exporter and importer changes together; do not merge an importer-only external schema break.
Reject old transfer schema versions and old package fingerprints after the streaming cutover with clear unsupported-schema or unsupported-fingerprint errors.
Same-branch export/import round trips preserve counts, warnings, dependency-resolution semantics, package checksums, and fingerprint semantics under the new schema version.

Export/import round trips cover `rawArticleProvenanceMode` `include` and `omit`, signed/credential URLs, imported snapshot reuse, disabled imported provider/model snapshots, judgments, assessments, and human review rows.
Add and run unsupported old-schema and old-fingerprint import rejection tests for the streaming cutover.
Add and run same-branch export/import tests for the new transfer schema version.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferAnalyze.test.ts` passes.
`bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferExport.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Add import export progress UX
userStories.description: As a user, I want long-running import and export sessions to show truthful phase, row, and byte progress in browser and desktop flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Expose progress phases for upload, package scan, staging load, fingerprint validation, analyze, dependency resolution, revalidation, asset promotion, commit, cleanup, export assembly, export asset staging, and export package write.
Show row progress only when row totals are reliable, byte progress only when byte totals are reliable, and avoid fake precision when total work is unknown.
Include stale-plan reason details in the plan review UI when commit revalidation reopens a plan.
Keep `/projects/import` and export entry points working in browser and desktop without suspending root layouts or replacing the whole page with spinners.
`bun test src/server/routes/projectTransferRoutes.test.ts` passes.
`bun run test:vitest -- src/app/routes/+projects/-+import.vitest.tsx` passes if import/export progress payloads, warning grouping, or wizard behavior changes.
`bun test src/app/routes/+projects/importWizard/projectImportClient.test.ts` passes if upload headers, session URLs, or upload progress wiring changes.
`bun run test:vitest -- src/components/main/projectsGrid.vitest.tsx` passes if import/export progress UX or entry-point behavior changes.
`bun run build` passes if shared UI, route response types, or import wizard progress changes.
`bun run desktop:build` passes if runtime asset paths, temp paths, upload/download wiring, or import/export UI paths change.
Browser verify import and export flows show useful phase progress and complete successfully.
Desktop verify the same flows when shared/core session, polling, progress, file upload/download, or temp-storage behavior changes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Run final benchmark matrix
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the completed import/export performance work benchmarked across representative package shapes so correctness, memory, and writer occupancy improvements are documented.
acceptanceCriteria: Run the benchmark matrix for small inline, article-heavy, judgment-heavy, asset-heavy, reuse-heavy, conflict-heavy, and large export package shapes.

Record before/after median and worst-run results for wall time, phase times, rows/sec, bytes/sec, peak memory, DuckDB spill, writer transaction duration, temporary disk bytes, final asset bytes, conflict shape, revalidation outcome, warning counts/details, and correctness checks.
Include the small inline package fixture for every shared/core import or export path change and confirm small-package latency does not regress more than 5% unless explicitly justified.
Confirm large package rows/sec or bytes/sec improves at least 10% for the targeted bottleneck phase, or document correctness, memory, or writer-duration improvement as the explicit win.
Confirm JS heap growth is bounded by active batch size plus asset copy buffers and DuckDB writer transaction duration does not increase for commit-writer changes.

Attach benchmark results to the implementation note or PR, including package fingerprint, schema version, raw article provenance mode when applicable, dependency execution signature, and warning details validation.
`bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=small-inline-package` passes and reports machine-readable output.
`bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=article-heavy-package` passes and reports machine-readable output.
`bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=judgment-heavy-package` passes and reports machine-readable output.
`bun run bench:project-transfer -- --fixture=asset-heavy-package` passes and reports machine-readable output.
`bun run lint` passes.
